scenes.description: Shane sits at a small table with Shary and Zoe, both of whom are sipping lattes and waiting for his response about which blogging platform he will use for his new project. The atmosphere is casual, and the three are deep in conversation.

actions.dialogue: Shane, I really think you should go with WordPress. It’s free, it’s widely used, and you can build a professional blog with it. Mood icons aren’t a big deal, and you can always add them later if you really want.

actions.action: Emphasizes the importance of mood icons
actions.dialogue: But Shane, mood icons are part of your voice. They add personality to your posts. You should use something like Tumblr or Medium, even if they cost a bit more. Your readers deserve to see the real you.

I get both of your points. WordPress is practical, and I can’t argue with the cost. But Zoe’s right—those icons are important to how I express myself. I just don’t know if I can afford to prioritize creativity over practicality.
What if we find a free platform that still supports mood icons? Maybe there’s something in the middle. You don’t have to choose extremes.
Shane, your blog is a reflection of who you are. If you start compromising on the small things, like icons, you might end up compromising on your whole style. Don’t lose sight of your voice.

scenes.plot: Shane is trying to decide on a blogging platform for his new project. His friend Shary suggests a free, formal platform like WordPress, while his colleague Zoe insists on using one with mood icons to preserve his creative and authentic voice. The conversation reveals Shane’s internal struggle between practicality and self-expression, and both friends try to guide him toward a decision that aligns with his values.
scenes.social_purpose: To explore Shane’s values of self-expression and practicality through a realistic social interaction with peers who represent different priorities. The scenario highlights how social dynamics and personal experiences influence decision-making in digital content creation.
